main_text.l: Quod fit tam in infimo aere supra terram, quàm
in ipsis cavernosis locis subtus terram.
Simile quid nebulæ quandoq; apparet, quando
tempore magni æstus, ob copiam siccarum exha-
lationum magnâ copiâ elevatarum, aer caliginos-
us interdiu redditur.
Adjuncta horum meteororum, sunt pictura & co-
lorationes informes aliæ: factæ vel à lumine certarum
stellarum, vel ab inflammata exhalatione aliqua.
A stellarum lumine pictura in nube & nebula co-
mmuniter fit, Halo dicta. in nube autem sola fiunt,
tum parelii & paraselenæ, tum iris.
Halo est pictura circuli colorati, circa stellam
clariorem in nube vel nebula, quæ inter visum
nostrum & stellam æquabilis minusq;, crassa in-
terjicitur, efformata.
Hæc ut fiat, primum necesse est, ut per nebulam
aut nubem, exiguæ æquabilisq; densitatis, (qua-
lis rarò compingitur: unde etiam sæpius in ne-
bula, quàm nube, Halo conspicitur) circumcir-
ca eodem modo, & ad æquales angulos, radii
luminosi ad nostrum visum refringi queant.
Quare sub Luna creberrimè apparent halones,
quòd ejus debile lumen facilè in corpore vapo-
roso, minùs etiam crasso, frangatur. Rarissimè
sub Sole: quia forte illius lumen ejusmodi nube-
culam aut nebulam facilè penetrat, aut etiam dis-
cutit. Sub reliquis stellis clarioribus tantùm conspi-
citur, ut sub Jove, Venere, ac quibusdam insi-
gnio-

page.notes: The last word of the page is printed as "gnio-" at the foot right, continued from "insig-" on the line above; it is printed as "gnio-" and carries a hyphen, so it is a catchword-like split word; I have kept it at the end of the text as printed. Marginal references in the left margin were not legible enough to transcribe with confidence. The half-word "Hælo"/"Halo" and the line "A stellarum lumine... dicta" contain a visible overprint; the reading "dicta" is uncertain and should be checked. Some words in the passage ("stellarum", "nubeculam") may be misread due to scan quality.
